name: request_capture
description: Disabled by default. Request a recipe-bound capture, optionally sharing its selected results; capture and sharing approvals are independent. Submit either the explicit shape or the reviewed preview request with its expected_plan_digest; a changed plan returns ReviewChanged. A recordingSave preview dispatches only its pinned existing-source snapshots under reviewed policy scope, never the full recipe. A retry with the same idempotency key returns the original capture and never recollects; a different request under that key is Conflict.

cluster.description: Cluster name as configured in the hub (ADR-335 D4).

recipe.description: EvidenceRecipe name; the hub records its digest (ADR-335 D4).

preview.description: The preview_capture request that was reviewed (new capture, history repeat or recording save). Submission recomputes its plan.

cluster.description: Cluster name as configured in the hub (ADR-335 D4).

requested_retention_seconds.description: Requested evidence-access lifetime in seconds. Omission uses the administrator default; effective access and managed deletion remain bounded by current retention policy and its deletion budget. History restoration preserves its original request; use a normal edited preview to change it.

history_selection.description: Explicit manual selection when repeating a policy triggeringPod occurrence; the preview selects a current eligible Pod under the original workload identity.

expected_plan_digest.description: plan_digest of the reviewed preview. A different recomputed plan returns ReviewChanged with the differences; nothing is accepted.

recipe_digest.description: Optional provenance pin: refuse when the named recipe's digest differs.

namespace.description: Defaults to the object's own namespace; must equal it when given.

uid.description: Optional pin with adoption: pinUID; otherwise provenance only.

maxPods.description: Maximum pods collected per occurrence; never the monitoring coverage limit.

selection.description: Defaults to triggeringPod for policies and oldestReady for manual captures.

recipients.description: No count limit: recipients are bounded only by the request body byte limit (memory) (maintainer rule: limits need a reason).

items.description: Current MCP tool names; raw operations use the grant vocabulary. get_extract views are further limited by the selected data classes.

notAfter.description: Optional; defaults to the access end (AccessUntil) of the collected evidence, capped by the administrator maximum. No deadline restarts when an artifact arrives.

d5.description: Result access covers every OAuth client and browser session of the same human; clients carry the user's own evidence access (maintainer decision).

version.description: Optional; omitted, the hub resolves the current version and records it.

d10.description: Peer generations are bounded only by the compiled program limit (BPF_MAXINSNS 4096).

d11.description: No length cap on the text; the bound is the compiled classic BPF program, which must fit the kernel limit BPF_MAXINSNS (4096 instructions), checked at compile, and the enclosing Kubernetes object size.

segments.description: Segment count; segment size is maxBytes ÷ segments. At least 2 so the ring can rotate; evicting one segment drops 1/segments of history.

d14.description: In-memory ring; a saved window copies at most maxBytes. The collector memory formula (specs/packets.md REQ-NET-003) bounds all rings on a node.

maxProcesses.description: The default batch covers every resolved main process of the Pod, sidecars included; the batch is bounded by maxProcesses × maxBytesPerProcess ≤ the action maxBytes and by maxTotalStop.

maxBytesPerProcess.description: Bounded only by the action and capture byte budget.

d24.description: Reviewed observation rate; the shipped default is derived from measured per-node collector event throughput. With the ring, it bounds every trace; there is no lifetime event total (ADR-335 D6).
